notebooks.title: 核对偏导与多路径反例

cells.code:
x,y,t = sp.symbols('x y t', real=True)
h = 10-x*x-2*y*y
print("高度/两个偏导:", h.subs({x:1,y:1}), sp.diff(h,x), sp.diff(h,y))
print("站位偏导:", sp.diff(h,x).subs(x,1), sp.diff(h,y).subs(y,1))
print("向东真实高度/变化:", h.subs({x:sp.Rational(11,10),y:1}), h.subs({x:sp.Rational(11,10),y:1})-7)
F = x*y/(x*x+y*y)
print("轴向极限/斜向极限:", sp.limit(F.subs(y,0),x,0), sp.limit(F.subs(y,x),x,0))
print("原点偏导差商:", sp.limit(sp.Integer(0)/t,t,0), sp.limit(sp.Integer(0)/t,t,0))

notebooks.title: 核对局部估计与方向导数

cells.code:
x,y = sp.symbols('x y', real=True)
h = 10-x*x-2*y*y
g = sp.Matrix([sp.diff(h,x),sp.diff(h,y)]).subs({x:1,y:1})
for dx,dy in [(sp.Rational(1,10),0),(sp.Rational(1,10),-sp.Rational(1,10))]:
    predicted = 7+g.dot(sp.Matrix([dx,dy]))
    actual = h.subs({x:1+dx,y:1+dy})
    print("位移/预测/真实/误差:", dx,dy,predicted,actual,actual-predicted)
d = sp.Matrix([3,4])/5
print("单位方向/方向导数:", d.norm(),g.dot(d))
print("梯度长度/最大方向:",g.norm(),list(g/g.norm()))
tangent = sp.Matrix([2,-1])/sp.sqrt(5)
print("切向导数:",g.dot(tangent))

notebooks.title: 核对路径链式法则与雅可比

cells.code:
x,y,t = sp.symbols('x y t', real=True)
h = 10-x*x-2*y*y
path = {x:sp.cos(t),y:sp.sin(t)}
direct = sp.diff(h.subs(path),t)
chain = sp.diff(h,x).subs(path)*(-sp.sin(t))+sp.diff(h,y).subs(path)*sp.cos(t)
print("链式残差/路径导数:",sp.simplify(direct-chain),sp.simplify(direct))
print("pi/4处:",direct.subs(t,sp.pi/4))
g = sp.Matrix([h,x+y])
J = g.jacobian([x,y]).subs({x:1,y:1})
shift = sp.Matrix([sp.Rational(1,10),0])
actual = g.subs({x:1+shift[0],y:1})-g.subs({x:1,y:1})
print("J/预测/真实:",J.tolist(),list(J*shift),list(actual))

notebooks.title: 核对二阶近似与驻点边界

cells.code:
x,y = sp.symbols('x y', real=True)
h = 10-x*x-2*y*y
H = sp.hessian(h,(x,y))
dx,dy = sp.symbols('dx dy',real=True)
d = sp.Matrix([dx,dy])
print("山的Hessian/行列式:",H.tolist(),H.det())
print("二次项:",(d.T*H*d)[0]/2)
for f in [h,x*x-y*y,x**4+y**4]:
    grad = sp.Matrix([sp.diff(f,x),sp.diff(f,y)]).subs({x:0,y:0})
    hf = sp.hessian(f,(x,y)).subs({x:0,y:0})
    print("函数/原点梯度/Hessian/行列式:",f,list(grad),hf.tolist(),hf.det())
print("边界例的梯度:",list(sp.Matrix([sp.diff(x,x),sp.diff(x,y)])))

notebooks.title: 核对面积积分与中点近似

cells.code:
x,y = sp.symbols('x y',real=True)
h = 10-x*x-2*y*y
print("先y后x/先x后y:",sp.integrate(h,(y,0,1),(x,0,1)),sp.integrate(h,(x,0,1),(y,0,1)))
for N in [2,10]:
    total = sum(h.subs({x:sp.Rational(2*i+1,2*N),y:sp.Rational(2*j+1,2*N)}) for i in range(N) for j in range(N))/N**2
    print("网格N/面积和/小数:",N,total,float(total))

x,y,t = sp.symbols('x y t',real=True)
h = 10-x*x-2*y*y
F = x*y/(x*x+y*y)
print("题1:",sp.limit(F.subs(y,0),x,0),sp.limit(F.subs(y,x),x,0))
g = sp.Matrix([-2,-4])
shift = sp.Matrix([sp.Rational(1,10),-sp.Rational(1,10)])
pred = 7+g.dot(shift)
actual = h.subs({x:1+shift[0],y:1+shift[1]})
print("题2:",pred,actual,actual-pred)
print("题3:",g.dot(sp.Matrix([3,4])/5),g.norm(),list(g/g.norm()))
print("题4:",sp.diff(h.subs({x:sp.cos(t),y:sp.sin(t)}),t).subs(t,sp.pi/4))
J = sp.Matrix([h,x+y]).jacobian([x,y]).subs({x:1,y:1})
print("题4 J/变化:",J.tolist(),list(J*sp.Matrix([sp.Rational(1,10),0])))
print("题5:",[sp.hessian(f,(x,y)).subs({x:0,y:0}).det() for f in [h,x*x-y*y,x**4+y**4]])
points = [(sp.Rational(1,4),sp.Rational(1,4)),(sp.Rational(1,4),sp.Rational(3,4)),(sp.Rational(3,4),sp.Rational(1,4)),(sp.Rational(3,4),sp.Rational(3,4))]
heights = [h.subs({x:a,y:b}) for a,b in points]
print("题6高度/近似/误差:",heights,sum(heights)/4,sum(heights)/4-9)
